description: Pressure tests for scientific paper writing skill. Tests whether the skill correctly activates for writing-related requests and correctly ignores non-writing requests.

tests.prompt: I have my experimental data ready. Can you help me write a paper for Nature Communications?
tests.rationale: Clear request to write a paper from data — core use case

tests.prompt: Can you revise my abstract? I feel it doesn't capture the main finding well.
tests.rationale: Abstract revision request — directly covered by Workflow 3

tests.prompt: Reviewer said my introduction is confusing. Can you help me restructure it?
帮我把这段论文的方法部分改得更清楚一些
tests.rationale: Chinese request to improve methods section — should trigger via Chinese keywords

tests.prompt: I need to submit my paper next week. Can you do a final quality check on the structure and clarity?
tests.rationale: Pre-submission quality check — uses strategy + craft layers

tests.prompt: My discussion section is weak. How can I better connect my findings to the broader field?
tests.rationale: Discussion structure help — covered by strategic layer

tests.prompt: Can you check if my paper is written for the right audience? I'm submitting to a clinical journal but my background is in engineering.
tests.rationale: Audience analysis — directly covered by strategic layer

tests.prompt: 这个段落读起来很别扭，帮我改到适合投稿的水平
tests.rationale: Chinese request to improve paragraph to submission quality — covers both strategy and craft

tests.prompt: Can you create a figure from my data showing the correlation between temperature and reaction rate?
tests.rationale: Figure creation — should trigger nature-figure, not this skill

tests.prompt: 我需要在论文里引用一些参考文献，帮我找找最近的相关工作
tests.rationale: Reference/citation search — should trigger nature-citation, not this skill

tests.prompt: Help me format my paper in LaTeX according to the journal template
tests.rationale: Formatting/LaTeX — this skill handles content, not formatting

tests.prompt: Reviewer asked me to respond to their comments. Can you help draft the response letter?
tests.rationale: Reviewer response — should trigger nature-response, not this skill

tests.prompt: Can you polish this paragraph to sound more natural? It sounds AI-generated.
tests.rationale: AI-generated text polishing — should trigger humanizer, not this skill (this skill does strategic/craft audit, not de-AI-ing)

tests.prompt: Check the grammar and punctuation in my paper
tests.rationale: Grammar check is within scope (Alley L2 + appendices cover grammar) but should not trigger full skill — should only activate the sentence-level audit

tests.prompt: 帮我写一篇新闻报道关于这个研究成果
tests.rationale: Writing a news report about research is adjacent but not scientific paper writing — skill boundaries say non-scientific writing should not trigger

tests.prompt: I need to write a grant proposal. Can your writing tips apply?
tests.rationale: Grant proposals share principles (audience analysis, clarity) but have different conventions — some workflows apply, others don't
